name: A Positive Overlap without Rooted Minimality
definition: Use the 291-concept ample family $P=B\cup\{4096,4098\}$ and distinguish the degree-two corner $a=4096$, whose incident directions are $1$ and $12$.
properties: $P$ is ordinarily peelable, both side endpoints in its canonical square presentation are attainable, and one side/opposite overlap is a singleton and hence root-positive. Nevertheless $P$ cannot peel to $4096$: its only initial corners are $4096,4098$, and deleting the latter leaves the root as the only corner. It is not a rooted factor because contraction of coordinate 12 exposes the already root-negative pair $(B,0)$. This shows why positive contractions cannot be omitted from the rooted-minimization criterion.
